blocks.text: Microsegmentation APIs enable customers and partners to visualize workload traffic flows, manage segmentation policies, and query agent and resource telemetry through a single GraphQL endpoint on OneAPI.

blocks.item: The API uses two root types for all operations:
Query: To retrieve existing information (read-only). This is conceptually similar to a GET request in a REST API.
Mutation: To create, update, or delete objects in the system. This is conceptually similar to POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE requests in a REST API.
Common input patterns:
Pagination: page or pageNum and pageSize.
Sorting: sort and sortDir (ASC or DESC).
Filtering: Filter inputs tailored to each resource (e.g., ResourceGroupsFilter).
Multiple queries per request: GraphQL can execute multiple queries in one request. The response is successful only when all queries succeed; otherwise the request returns errors.
Handling Errors:
Errors are reported within the response body. A request can fail at the service level, while still returning an HTTP 200 OK response code. Always check the response body for errors.
View a sample error format

{ "errors": [ { "message": "Data fetching Failed: Forbidden to use API", "locations": [ { "line": 51, "column": 9 } ], "path": [ "agentGroupUpdate", "protocols" ], "extensions": { "code": "FORBIDDEN", "http_status": 403, "classification": "INTERNAL_ERROR" } } ], "data": { "agentGroupUpdate": { "protocols": { "entries": [] } } } }

blocks.text: The following data domains are available to be queried via the Microsegmentation APIs.
Root query type is available for management and policy APIs. Use it to retrieve agents, groups, statistics, metadata, nonces, and microsegmentation resources.

blocks.item: Query type operations
AgentConnectionStatusStatisticsConnection: Return aggregated agent connection status statistics for the specified customer.
agentGroups: Return a paged list of agent groups for the specified customer. Supports search and sorting.
agentVersionStatistics: Return aggregated agent version statistics for the specified customer.
agents: Return a paged list of agents for the specified customer. Supports search and sorting.
metadata: Return event metadata for the specified customer as a JSON object.
nonce: Return a nonce for the specified eyezId.
nonces: Return a paged list of nonces for the specified customer. Supports search and sorting.
appZones: Return app zones for the specified customer. Supports filtering and sorting.
defaultPolicyRules: Return default policy rules for the specified customer with pagination.
policyRules: Return policy rules for the specified customer. Supports filtering, pagination, and fetch-all.
recommendedResourceGroups: : Return ML-based recommended resource groups for the specified customer. Supports filtering and pagination.
resourceGroupMembers: Return resources that belong to the specified resource group.
resourceGroupProtectionStatus: Return protection status for resource groups with optional detail per group.
resourceGroups: Return resource groups for the specified customer. Supports filtering and pagination.
resourceProtectionStatus: Return protection status for resources with optional detail per resource.
resources: Return resources that match the specified filters. Supports sorting, pagination, and inclusion of deleted resources.
resourcesByFilters: Return resources filtered by multiple criteria for resource group recommendations.

blocks.text: Root mutation type is available for management and policy operations. Use it to create, update, or delete agents, groups, nonces, policy rules, and resource groups.

blocks.item: Mutation type operations
agentDelete: Remove an existing agent.
agentGroupCreate: Create a new agent group.
agentGroupDelete: Delete an agent group.
agentGroupUpdate: Update an existing agent group.
agentGroupUpgradeStatusReset: Reset the upgrade status of an agent group.
agentUpdate: Update an existing agent.
nonceCreate: Create a new nonce (provisioning key) for an existing agent group.
nonceDelete: Delete a nonce.
nonceUpdate: Update an existing nonce.
nonceWithAgentGroupCreate: Create a new nonce (provisioning key) and a new agent group.
defaultPolicyRulesCreate: Create default policy rules in batch.
defaultPolicyRulesDelete: Delete multiple default policy rules in batch.
defaultPolicyRulesUpdate: Update multiple default policy rules in batch.
managedRecommendedResourceGroupUpdate: Update a recommended resource group.
managedResourceGroupCreate: Create a managed resource group.
managedResourceGroupUpdate: Update a managed resource group.
policyRuleCreate: Create a policy rule.
policyRuleDelete: Delete a policy rule.
policyRuleUpdate: Update a policy rule.
resourceGroupDelete: Delete a resource group.
unmanagedResourceGroupCreate: Create an unmanaged resource group.
unmanagedResourceGroupUpdate: Update an unmanaged resource group.
